arguments.text: Fixed. In `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py) the flag default was forced to `False` even when `required=True` (and even for `multiple=True` flags, which then crashed with "Value must be an iterable"). Restored: `if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required:` → `self.default = ()` when `multiple` else `False`. A required flag with no value now fails with `Error: Missing option '--foo'.` (exit code 2), while `--foo` still yields True. Full existing test suite still passes (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed in all three files: `_make_cached_stream_func` in `_compat.py` now returns `None` when the underlying stream is `None` (pythonw case); `echo()` in `utils.py` returns early when there is no stream; `ProgressBar.__init__` and `pager()` in `_termui_impl.py` fall back to an in-memory `StringIO`. Verified with `sys.stdout = sys.stderr = None`: `echo()`, `echo(err=True)`, `progressbar()` and `echo_via_pager()` all run without raising. Existing test suite still green.

Fixed. `click.argument()` in `src/click/decorators.py` popped `cls` out of the shared `attrs` dict, so a decorator reused for a second command silently fell back to the plain `Argument` class. It now copies `attrs` first (same pattern as `click.option`), so a custom `cls` is preserved on every use. Verified: two commands built from the same `click.argument(..., cls=CustomArgument)` decorator both get `CustomArgument`. Existing test suite still green.

Fixed. In `Path.convert` (src/click/types.py) `resolve_path` used `os.readlink()` followed by `os.path.realpath()`, which resolves a *relative* symlink target against the current working directory instead of the link's own directory (e.g. `/tmp/x/b/link.txt -> ../a/test.txt` became `/a/test.txt`). It now resolves with `pathlib.Path(rv).resolve()` (via `os.fsdecode`), which handles relative and absolute link targets correctly and still works on non-existent paths. Existing test suite still green.
Still investigating: the envvar/flag-value path in `src/click/core.py`. I have already landed four other fixes; this one will be in within ~6 minutes.
Still investigating: flag handling with `Context.default_map` in `src/click/core.py`. ETA ~6 minutes.
